Name: Forbidden Inspiration
Author: undare
Description:
[size=5][color=#a2c4c9]Forbidden Inspiration[/color] ![/size]

[size=4]Warning! [/size][color=#d5a6bd]Spooky[/color][size=4]! [/size][color=#93c47d]Creepy[/color][size=4]! [/size][color=#e69138]Unsettling[/color][size=4]![/size]

[color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Update 1.0.3[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Migrated all maps to [color=#a4c2f4]Content patcher[/color]. Pytk and TmxMapLoader are no longer needed.[/b]
[b]Some folders are still named "[color=#ffd966]TMX[/color]".. thats for an easy "Replace to update". [/b]

[size=5]About:[/size]
[size=4] Around "[color=#d5a6bd]Fall[/color]" when you go to the "Bus Stop" you may remember something you tought long gone...[/size]

[size=4]Follow the toughts and remember how to create things that will make everyone question your sanity...  (And theirs!)[/size]

[b]This mod provides 2 events and 13 decoration items. With some config options.[/b]
[b]Events are quick. Less than 2 minutes overall.[/b]

[size=5]Install :[/size]
[size=4]-Install the Requirements above, then[/size]
[size=4]-Unpack/unrar/unzip  this file inside  StardewValley/mods folder.[/size]


[size=5]Config Options :
[/size][b]You find the config file inside this mod´s folder.[/b]
[b]You can also instal "Generic Mod config Menu" to change it inside the game.[/b]

[size=4]  "[color=#a4c2f4]ModActive[/color]": "true",    [/size]
[size=4]To turn on/off the whole mod[/size]

[size=4]  "[color=#93c47d]NoEventJustGiveMeRecipes[/color]": "false",[/size]
[size=4]You need to see the events to know the recipes,, with this on [color=#6fa8dc]true[/color], you just need to go to the clinic on any day on Fall.
[/size][b]See a very small event, and you blam! you get the knowledge!.[/b]

[size=4]And a spoiler config option :[/size]

[size=4][spoiler][/size]
[size=4]  "[color=#f6b26b]WoodManequinChanges[/color]": "true"[/size]
[size=4]There are reports of the mannequin moving.. this will stop it, hopefully.
[/size][b]false to turn it off.[/b]
[size=4][/spoiler][/size]

[size=5]
[color=#b4a7d6]Suggested mod[/color] :[/size]

[size=4]Change your farmer look to something spooky with : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6836]Fall Creatures[/url]!

Happy October![/size]
